indications: short-term management of anxiety/anxiety with insomnia

dosing.anxiety_adults: 50-100 mg up to four times daily (50-200 mg/day total; common 50 mg at night or 25-50 mg up to tds/qds for short-term anxiety)
dosing.elderly: 25 mg at night, lower total daily dose

adverse_effects: anticholinergic effects (dry mouth, constipation, urinary retention)
QT prolongation risk at high doses - avoid in prolonged QT/electrolyte disturbance/cardiac disease
cautions: avoid in elderly with dementia/cognitive impairment (anticholinergic burden); avoid combining with other QT-prolonging drugs
